gloss: to brood over; to take too much to heart

definitions.gloss: to brood over; to dwell on until desperate
definitions.explanation: To think about one problem so intensely and for so long that one sees no way out; often implies the danger of a rash act.

examples.japanese: ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{思|おも}い{詰|つ}めないで。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}い{詰|つ}めた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She had a desperate, brooding look on her face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{思|おも}い{詰|つ}める⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: Before you brood over it all alone, I wish you'd talk to someone.

notes:
Stronger than worrying: the person has fixed on one thought and may act on it. {思|おも}い{詰|つ}めた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ / ⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧ (a desperate look) and the warning ⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{思|おも}い{詰|つ}めないで are the commonest uses.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: what one broods over takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, usually as ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{詰|つ}める); often used with no object

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{悩|なや}む→思い悩む：33976_omoinayamu⟧: to agonize over; long worrying, without the sense of desperation
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{込|こ}む→考え込む：21866_kangaekomu⟧: to be lost in thought; can be calm
